title: Cagetti2005tk: a partial-equilibrium reproduction of the household Bellman system in Cagetti & De Nardi (2006)
description: REMARK-in-progress (standard tier) that solves the household-side Bellman system of Cagetti & De Nardi (2006), 'Entrepreneurship, Frictions, and Wealth' (Journal of Political Economy 114(5), 835-870), in partial equilibrium at the paper's Table 5 calibration, using the SolvingMicroDSOPs Endogenous Grid Method stage. See REMARK.md for the detailed scope (occupational choice, value functions, calibrated parameters, persisted artifacts) and for what is *not* reproduced (the full general-equilibrium fixed point, the four-status demographic kernel, the estate-tax counterfactual).
